Enclosed please find the recipt for the amount paid in full. Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before Friday. He received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, aly let me know whether the Phen it me here white the shipment arunk in god order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full.
